title: Building safety placard
description: A post-earthquake building safety placard in the three standard categories: INSPECTED (lawful occupancy permitted), RESTRICTED USE (entry limited as written) and UNSAFE (do not enter or occupy). The category is always written as words. It carries the building address, date and time, inspector and any restrictions.

restrictions.description: Restrictions or the hazard (for restricted use or unsafe)
examples: Do not enter the north stairwell or the second-floor east wing. Ground floor open for daytime use only.
Cracking in the north stairwell wall. Re-inspect after the next significant aftershock.
